title: Strip configuration
statement: For a Boolean input list $x$, a state $q$ that is either one of the four states or the halting state, an input-head index $i$ with $i \leq |x|$, a Boolean list $w$, an integer $h$, and a Boolean output list, this is the configuration whose input-head position is $i+1$. Its work tape contains the buffer represented by $w$, its work-head position is $h$, and its output tape contains the given output list.
hypotheses_covered: Optional state from the four-state set
Natural input index $i$ bounded by the input length
